title: The Omnivore's Dilemma
author: Michael Pollan
summary: Michael Pollan follows four meals, from industrial corn to a hunted and foraged dinner, to show where modern American food comes from and what that means for how we should choose what to eat.
readIf: you want to understand the food system behind your plate with a curious, readable guide.
skipIf: you want a diet plan or concrete recipes.
